name: Tweet Reply Optimizer with Self-Improving Prompts

nodes.name: Fetch Tweet Data
nodes.notes:
Fetches tweet data including text and media from Twitter API. Requires Twitter OAuth2 credentials.

ALTERNATIVE: Use a tweet scraper API like RapidAPI's Twitter scraper if you don't have Twitter API access.

parameters.query:
SELECT id, prompt_text, version
FROM system_prompts
WHERE prompt_type = 'vision_writer'
AND is_active = true
LIMIT 1;

nodes.name: Vision/Writing Agent (OpenRouter)
nodes.notes:
Calls vision-capable LLM via OpenRouter API.

Supported providers:
- OpenRouter: https://openrouter.ai
- Featherless: https://featherless.ai

Change the URL and model as needed.

Recommended models:
- anthropic/claude-3.5-sonnet (best quality)
- openai/gpt-4o (good alternative)
- google/gemini-pro-vision (cost-effective)

parameters.formDescription: =Review the generated reply and provide feedback to improve the AI system.

nodes.name: Prepare Optimization Context
nodes.notes: Runs when decision is 'revise' or 'reject' to prepare context for the Prompt Optimizer Agent

parameters.query:
SELECT id, prompt_text, version
FROM system_prompts
WHERE prompt_type = 'prompt_optimizer'
AND is_active = true
LIMIT 1;

=-- First, deactivate old prompts
SELECT deactivate_old_prompts('vision_writer');

-- Insert new prompt version
INSERT INTO system_prompts (
  prompt_text,
  prompt_type,
  version,
  is_active,
  created_by,
  model_used,
  notes,
  parent_version
) VALUES (
  {{ $json.new_prompt_text | toJsonString }},
  'vision_writer',
  {{ $json.new_version_number }},
  true,
  'prompt_optimizer_agent',
  {{ $json.optimizer_model | toJsonString }},
  {{ $json.optimization_rationale | toJsonString }},
  {{ $json.prompt_version_id }}
)
RETURNING id, version;

nodes.name: Log Interaction to Database
nodes.notes: Logs all interaction data including tweet, reply, feedback, and optimization results

parameters.responseBody:
={
  "success": true,
  "tweet_id": {{ $json.tweet_id | toJsonString }},
  "generated_reply": {{ $json.generated_reply | toJsonString }},
  "user_decision": {{ $json.user_decision | toJsonString }},
  "user_rating": {{ $json.user_rating }},
  "new_prompt_created": {{ $json.new_prompt_created }},
  "new_prompt_version": {{ $json.new_prompt_id || null }},
  "message": "Tweet reply interaction logged successfully"
}
